```python
import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import pychrono.vehicle.terrain as veh_terrain
from pychrono.vehicle.wheeled_vehicle import WheeledVehicleVisualSystemIrrlicht
from pychrono.vehicle.wheeled_vehicle import ChWheeledVehicleVisualSystemType

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Set up the PyChrono environment
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Create the vehicle system
vehicle_system = veh.WheeledVehicle()

# Set up the simulation parameters
time_step = 0.02  # 50 FPS
max_simulation_time = 30.0

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create the vehicle
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Vehicle location and orientation
vehicle_location = chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0.5)
vehicle_rotation = chrono.ChQuaternionD(1, 0, 0, 0)  # Default orientation

# Create and initialize the HMMWV
hmmwv = veh.HMMWV()
hmmwv.SetContactMethod(chrono.ChContactMethod_SMC)
hmmwv.SetChassisFixed(False)
hmmwv.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysD(vehicle_location, vehicle_rotation))
hmmwv.SetTireType(veh.TMeasyTire)
hmmwv.SetTireStepSize(time_step)
hmmwv.Initialize()

# Add the HMMWV to the vehicle system
vehicle_system.AddVehicle(hmmwv)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create the terrain
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Terrain dimensions and properties
terrain_length = 100.0  # meters
terrain_width = 100.0   # meters
terrain_height = 0.0    # flat terrain
terrain_texture = "concrete.jpg"  # You'll need to provide this texture

# Create the rigid terrain
terrain = veh_terrain.RigidTerrain(vehicle_system.GetSystem())
terrain.SetContactFrictionCoefficient(0.8)
terrain.SetContactRestitutionCoefficient(0.1)
terrain.SetContactMaterialProperties(2e7, 0.3)
terrain.SetTexture(terrain_texture)
terrain.Initialize(terrain_length, terrain_width)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create the driver system
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Create an interactive driver for steering, throttle, and braking
driver = veh.ChInteractiveDriverIRR(vehicle_system)
driver.SetSteeringDelta(0.02)
driver.SetThrottleDelta(0.01)
driver.SetBrakingDelta(0.02)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Set up visualization
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Create the Irrlicht application
vis = chronoirr.ChIrrApp(vehicle_system.GetSystem(), "HMMWV Simulation", chronoirr.dimension2du(1280, 720))
vis.AddLogo()
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AddCamera(chrono.ChVectorD(5, 5, 2), chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0.5))
vis.AddTypicalLights()
vis.AddLightWithShadow(chrono.ChVectorD(1, 1, 3), chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0), 3, 0.5, 4, 40, 512)

# Create the vehicle visualization system
vehicle_vis = WheeledVehicleVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vehicle_vis.SetVehicle(hmmwv)
vehicle_vis.SetWindowTitle("HMMWV")
vehicle_vis.SetChaseCamera(chrono.ChVectorD(0.0, 0.0, 1.75), 6.0, 0.5)
vehicle_vis.Initialize()

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Simulation loop
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Number of simulation steps
num_steps = int(max_simulation_time / time_step)

# Run the simulation
while vis.Run():
    # Get the current time
    time = vehicle_system.GetChTime()

    # Update the driver inputs
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Update the vehicle state
    vehicle_system.Update(time_step)

    # Update the visualization
    vis.BeginScene()
    vis.Render()
    vehicle_vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)
    vehicle_vis.Advance(time_step)
    vis.EndScene()

    # Exit if simulation time is exceeded
    if time > max_simulation_time:
        break

# Clean up
vehicle_system.RemoveVehicle(hmmwv)
```

```python
trackPoint = chrono.ChVector3d(-3.0, 0.0, 1.1)

# Contact method
contact_method = chrono.ChContactMethod_NSC
contact_vis = False

# Simulation step sizes
step_size = 1e-3
tire_step_size = step_size

# Time interval between two render frames
render_step_size = 1.0 / 50  # FPS = 50

# Create the HMMWV vehicle, set parameters, and initialize
vehicle = veh.HMMWV_Full()
vehicle.SetContactMethod(contact_method)
vehicle.SetChassisCollisionType(chassis_collision_type)
vehicle.SetChassisFixed(False)
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysd(initLoc, initRot))
vehicle.SetTireType(tire_model)
vehicle.SetTireStepSize(tire_step_size)
vehicle.Initialize()

vehicle.SetChassisVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSteeringVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetWheelVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetTireVisualizationType(vis_type)

vehicle.GetSystem().SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)

# Create the terrain
patch_mat = chrono.ChContactMaterialNSC()
patch_mat.SetFriction(0.9)
patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(vehicle.GetSystem())
patch = terrain.AddPatch(patch_mat, chrono.ChCoordsysd(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT), terrainLength, terrainWidth)
patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/tile4.jpg"), 200, 200)
patch.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.8, 0.5))
terrain.Initialize()

# Create the vehicle Irrlicht interface
vis = veh.ChWheeledVehicleVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.SetWindowTitle('HMMWV Path Following Demo')
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 1024)
vis.SetChaseCamera(trackPoint, 6.0, 0.5)
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
vis.AddLightDirectional()
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AttachVehicle(vehicle.GetVehicle())

# =============================================
# Path Following Implementation
# =============================================

# Circular path parameters
circle_radius = 20.0  # meters
circle_center = chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0)

# PID controller parameters
Kp = 0.5  # Proportional gain
Ki = 0.01  # Integral gain
Kd = 0.1  # Derivative gain

# Controller state
integral_error = 0
prev_error = 0

# Constant throttle
throttle = 0.3

# Create visualization spheres for path points
sentinel_sphere = chrono.ChBodyEasySphere(0.5, 1000, True, True)
sentinel_sphere.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(circle_radius, 0, 0.5))
sentinel_sphere.SetBodyFixed(True)
sentinel_sphere.GetVisualModel().SetColor(chrono.ChColor(1, 0, 0))  # Red
vehicle.GetSystem().Add(sentinel_sphere)

target_sphere = chrono.ChBodyEasySphere(0.5, 1000, True, True)
target_sphere.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(circle_radius, 0, 0.5))
target_sphere.SetBodyFixed(True)
target_sphere.GetVisualModel().SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0, 1, 0))  # Green
vehicle.GetSystem().Add(target_sphere)

# =============================================
# Simulation Loop
# =============================================

# Number of simulation steps between miscellaneous events
render_steps = math.ceil(render_step_size / step_size)

# Initialize simulation frame counter
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

while vis.Run():
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data
    if (step_number % render_steps == 0):
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Get vehicle state
    vehicle_pos = vehicle.GetVehicle().GetPos()
    vehicle_rot = vehicle.GetVehicle().GetRot()
    vehicle_vel = vehicle.GetVehicle().GetPos_dt()

    # Calculate current angle in the circular path
    current_angle = math.atan2(vehicle_pos.y - circle_center.y, vehicle_pos.x - circle_center.x)

    # Calculate sentinel point (point ahead of vehicle)
    lookahead_distance = 5.0
    sentinel_angle = current_angle + lookahead_distance / circle_radius
    sentinel_x = circle_center.x + circle_radius * math.cos(sentinel_angle)
    sentinel_y = circle_center.y + circle_radius * math.sin(sentinel_angle)
    sentinel_pos = chrono.ChVector3d(sentinel_x, sentinel_y, 0.5)

    # Calculate target point (point further ahead)
    target_angle = sentinel_angle + 0.2  # small angle ahead
    target_x = circle_center.x + circle_radius * math.cos(target_angle)
    target_y = circle_center.y + circle_radius * math.sin(target_angle)
    target_pos = chrono.ChVector3d(target_x, target_y, 0.5)

    # Update visualization spheres
    sentinel_sphere.SetPos(sentinel_pos)
    target_sphere.SetPos(target_pos)

    # Calculate steering error (cross track error)
    vehicle_to_sentinel = sentinel_pos - vehicle_pos
    vehicle_to_sentinel.Normalize()

    # Vehicle forward direction in world coordinates
    vehicle_forward = vehicle_rot.Rotate(chrono.ChVector3d(1, 0, 0))

    # Calculate the angle between vehicle forward and path tangent
    error = math.atan2(vehicle_to_sentinel.Cross(vehicle_forward).z,
                      vehicle_to_sentinel.Dot(vehicle_forward))

    # PID control
    integral_error += error
    derivative_error = (error - prev_error) / step_size
    steering_command = Kp * error + Ki * integral_error + Kd * derivative_error
    prev_error = error

    # Limit steering command to [-1, 1]
    steering_command = max(-1.0, min(1.0, steering_command))

    # Create driver inputs
    driver_inputs = veh.ChDriverInputs()
    driver_inputs.m_throttle = throttle
    driver_inputs.m_steering = steering_command
    driver_inputs.m_braking = 0.0

    # Update modules (process inputs from other modules)
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)
```
